I am writing to formally apply for a personal loan. I am a 57-year-old married homeowner residing at 567 Antonio Forges, New Antoniostad, WV 71119, and I have been employed full-time as a senior accountant at Cross & Associates for a number of years.

My risk of foreclosure was assessed as low, and I have maintained stable employment throughout.

I am requesting this personal loan to address current financial needs and consolidate my obligations as I continue to strengthen my financial position. I am confident in my ability to repay the loan given my steady employment and income.

Please let me know what additional documentation you require to process my application. I am happy to provide pay stubs, bank statements, and any other information needed. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Andrew Cross
567 Antonio Forges
New Antoniostad, WV 71119
